name: Counterspell
description:
Trigger: A creature within medium range casts a spell.

You attempt to counter the spell. If the spell includes a skill check as part of its initial effect, roll Lore vs that skill. Otherwise, roll Lore vs Awareness.

Either way, on a win, the casting fails and any resources required for the spell are consumed. On a loss, the spell is cast as normal.

Describe how you counter the spell.
successes:
✨: On a loss, you may to attempt the opposed roll a second time (but not a third time), ill-favored.

🌞: On a win, you may allow the spell to be cast, but with the caster as the target of the spell.

💀: If you're not already the target of the spell, you become the target. Check a Condition.
